## Objective
- Continue and finish the existing 3D adventure game, with combat, quests, level progression, rewards, a fruit shop, and a sand-power ability.

## Requirements
- Build a complete, playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Support phone/tablet play.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- The existing game is a Russian-language 3D island adventure with keyboard and touch controls; continue from that implementation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game implementation, UI, stylesheet, saved conversation, and package scripts.
- Installed dependencies with `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund`.
- Verified `npm run build` succeeds; Vite reports a chunk-size warning for the 506.91 kB JS bundle.

### Active
- Validate gameplay and responsive visuals, then fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- Browser screenshot validation: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because it expected Chromium at `/home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome`, which is not installed. The system has `/usr/bin/chromium`; inspect browser configuration or use an available browser setup to continue.

## Next Move
1. Open and inspect the running game at `http://localhost:3002`; resolve the browser executable mismatch.
2. Verify desktop and mobile layouts and core gameplay interactions; save and inspect a current JPEG screenshot.
3. Make any necessary fixes and rerun `npm run build`.
4. Finish with a brief summary and reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Three.js world, player/enemy behavior, combat, quests, shop, persistence, keyboard/touch controls.
- `src/style.css`: UI styling and responsive layouts.
- `index.html`: Game HUD, shop dialog, controls, and UI labels.
- `.omgithub/conversation.json`: Original request and prior session conversation.
- `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`: Browser launch settings relevant to screenshot testing.

## Important Context
- Original request: “Cделай игру где мы в 3д за человека идём убивать врагов у нас повышается уровень и мы за квест получяем денги а в магазине фруктов за 10 000 монет купим 1 фрукт у фрукта есть сила песка (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)”
- Core gameplay is already implemented, including 5-enemy quest, 10,000-coin fruit purchase, sand skill, and touch joystick/action buttons. No source modifications were made in this continuation.
- Development server was started with `npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3002`.
